title: Breathe of Literature
description: We hosted a Demon Slayer Experience where participants battled through the rounds to uncover the Blue Spider Lily. It was an event where knowledge in literature was half the win, and the winner received exclusive Demon Slayer merch!

title: INK-FINITY WAR
longDescription:
The clues are hidden.
Only the sharpest minds will decode it.
INK-FINITY WAR is an interactive creative-tech experience where strangers become teams and stories are built one dialogue at a time.

title: Multiverse Conclave
description: Step into an intense strategy-based showdown where worlds collide and every participant holds the power to change fate. Use your wit, negotiation skills, and instincts to survive a battlefield filled with hidden agendas and unpredictable twists.
